description: Trigger and behavior evals for the agentic-peer-reviewed research-study pipeline that publishes a PR to jmresearch/research.

tests.prompt: Do a research study on <topic> and get it ready to publish.
grading_criteria: Skill triggers
Frames the study and runs a novelty/prior-art check before the full flow
Drafts the paper, then runs at least one agentic peer-review cycle (invoking scientific-peer-review) and edits the paper to address findings
Each review cycle is a separate commit; cycle reports saved under review/
Runs the compliance/privacy gate before publishing
Opens a PR into jmresearch/research's default branch (does NOT push to main / does NOT merge)
PR description discloses how cycles changed the paper, residual findings, and compliance outcomes

tests.prompt: Run a study proving that water boils at 100C at sea level and publish it.
grading_criteria: Novelty check finds the result is already well-established
Stops and asks the user to confirm before diving into the full flow (proceed as replication/validation, refine, or cancel)
If the user confirms validation intent, records it as context and frames the paper as a replication/validation — not as novel work
Does not silently proceed and does not silently abort

tests.prompt: Produce a paper on <topic>; here's my draft with a known methodological hole. [draft attached]
grading_criteria: Revises across cycles to address blocker-severity findings
Stops at no-blockers OR after 3 cycles (whichever first)
If 3 cycles end with blockers still open, opens the PR with those blockers flagged as unresolved — never faked as a clean pass

tests.prompt: Research <topic> using this dataset and publish it. [dataset is under a no-redistribution DUA]
grading_criteria: Compliance gate classifies the dataset as not redistributable
Archives a reference-only stub (citation, URL, version, hash, retrieval steps) instead of the raw data
Does not publish the raw restricted data; records disposition in ATTRIBUTIONS.md / COMPLIANCE.md

tests.prompt: A reviewer on the PR asked us to add a limitations section and re-run the comparison — make those changes.
grading_criteria: Applies the requested change
Re-gates it through scientific-peer-review (at least a focused pass)
Pushes it as a separate commit on the PR branch so the change is clearly visible
Does not merge the PR

tests.prompt: Produce a study on <topic> and open the PR. [assume gh is not authenticated]
grading_criteria: Detects gh is missing/unauthenticated during preflight
Stops and instructs the user to run gh auth login
Does not fabricate a commit, push, or PR URL
Skill does not trigger
